## Dispatcher.supportedMessageTypes property

Returns array of message types that dispatcher is able to handle. Message type format is MTURI specified at https://github.com/hyperledger/aries-rfcs/blob/main/concepts/0003-protocols/README.md\#mturi.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
get supportedMessageTypes(): string[];
```
